# Package list of the GENERATOR environment (vLLM 0.10, Python 3.10.18).
#
# Source: `site-packages/*.dist-info`. The environment's `conda-meta` was not
# read, so the conda layer is not captured; only `python 3.10.18` and `pip 25.2`
# are known.
#
# The environment does exactly one thing: it runs `vllm serve` with the generator
# checkpoint. Our code does not execute in it; the pipeline and the assistant
# live in the run environment (`run_env.txt`). When rebuilding, what matters is
# `python`, `vllm`, `torch` and whatever vLLM pulls in; the rest is inherited
# from an earlier setup and kept as is, so that "the same" means the same.
#
# Why there are two environments: vLLM 0.10.1.1 has no assistant architecture
# (`Qwen3VLForConditionalGeneration` is missing from its registry), while the run
# environment has vLLM 0.18.1. The `gdn-prefill-backend` flag does not exist in 0.10.
#
# `flash-attn` and `xformers` take long to build and must match torch: install
# them last and in a separate command, otherwise a failed build takes the whole
# installation down with it.

# `embreex` is NOT in this environment and is not installed: ray queries are made
# by the run, which uses 3.12 (`run_env.txt`).

# `flash-attn` cannot be built from source: it needs `nvcc` in /usr/local/cuda,
# which the node does not have. Install a prebuilt release wheel:
#
#   P=<environment python>; $P -c 'import torch; print(torch.__version__, torch._C._GLIBCXX_USE_CXX11_ABI)'
#   $P -m pip install --no-deps \
#     https://github.com/Dao-AILab/flash-attention/releases/download/v2.8.2/\
#     flash_attn-2.8.2%2Bcu12torch2.7cxx11abiTRUE-cp310-cp310-linux_x86_64.whl
#
# The ABI in the wheel name must match torch (here 2.7.1+cu126, abi TRUE).
# Do not skip it: the Qwen2-VL vision tower in vLLM uses `flash_attn` if present
# and SILENTLY falls back to another backend if it is not.
